name: HRC_ALERT_KEEPS
description: Contains alert expiry/time to live data.

columns.name: SENT_IN_RUN_ID
columns.description: Used to keep track of messages sent in this runId.

columns.name: ALERT_ID
columns.description: Alert Identifier. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERTS_B.ALERT_ID

columns.name: RECIPIENT_ID
columns.description: Recipient Identifier. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERT_RECIPIENTS.ALERT_ID

columns.name: SENT_TO
columns.description: Contains who the Keep is for.

columns.name: KEEP_COUNT
columns.description: Specifes number times not sent to recpient

columns.name: EXPIRES_ON
columns.description: The timestamp the Keep expires on

columns.name: HASH_KEY
columns.description: Feed recipient and body hash key.

columns.name: HASH_KEY_VERSION
columns.description: Feed recipient and body hash key version.

columns.name: OBJ_HASH_KEY
columns.description: Object hash key which holds surrogates key hash.

columns.name: OBJ_HASH_KEY_VERSION
columns.description: Object hash key which holds surrogates key hash version.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
